rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` has front matter with a name, so it is a bundled skill and a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.next`. The requirement says the workflow must end by naming the skill for the next task, or one skill per outcome when outcomes lead to different tasks.

The last workflow step, step 9, ends with "Next: for gap-list items the user decides, follow the habeas-requirements skill." That names a bundled skill for the follow-up task. The workflow ends in the checklist, and the Report and Gotchas sections after it are not workflow steps.

I considered whether the report's separate "evidence findings" and execution-coverage gaps are a different outcome that needs its own skill. The text doesn't clearly make them one. Step 7c already sends evidence work to habeas-evidence, and the front-matter description also points to habeas-evidence for stale evidence. The unmapped items that remain go to the gap list, which step 9 sends to habeas-requirements. I found no gap against the stated obligation. There are no violation matches to judge.

text: Each bundled skill's workflow MUST end by naming the bundled skill for the next task, or, when different outcomes lead to different tasks, the skill for each such outcome. An outcome that leads to no further task needs no skill named. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
